text: Looking for that raw shit, knowing where all the wild it be. RBA, Northside, Southside, West End. RIP swimmin' the crew, so put your vest in. Just plain sound, slicker than wet skin on a shaped push. Sippin' 40 bottles and blaze Kush. Leave you walking from the stage, but the days look like dang, dude. They got one hell of a playbook. Y'all just play crook and flee the scene. Me and the team get it by any means. Stayin' tighter than skinny jeans. From the east to the west, to the north, to the south. We run RBA, JPS, and that's it.
